REST API for the Chatbase custom AI chatbot / AI agent platform. Message an agent (with streaming), create and retrain chatbots/agents, update settings, list and delete agents, manage agent images, retrieve conversation history and captured leads, and manage contacts and their custom-attribute schema. All requests are authenticated with a Bearer API key created in the Chatbase dashboard under Workspace Settings -> API Keys.
